domains.name: Health Education and Complications
domains.summary: Indicates if health education was provided, presence of medical complications such as HELLP syndrome, HIV/AIDS, HPV, chronic hypertension, incompetent cervix, IUGR.

domains.name: Referrals and Housing Stability
domains.summary: Details about referrals to homemaker/home health services, housing authority, Medicaid, and whether the mother had stable housing during pregnancy.

domains.name: Hospital Overnight Stay
domains.summary: Indicates if infant was returned to hospital overnight after delivery, number of nights, age in weeks at time of stay.

domains.name: Housing Details
domains.summary: Specifics about unstable housing conditions and other housing situations.

domains.name: Infant Hospitalization
domains.summary: Date of infant's last discharge from hospital, total number of days hospitalized.

domains.name: Safety Topics Discussed
domains.summary: Topics discussed regarding infant safety such as abusive head trauma, bath safety, car seat use, emergency care locations.

domains.name: Evidence of Injury
domains.summary: Indicates if there was evidence of injury at death excluding birth process and specifies other injuries.

domains.name: Insurance Coverage
domains.summary: Payer source for labor and delivery, pregnancy, pre-pregnancy, post-pregnancy periods including Indian Health Service, Medicaid, private insurance.
